description: The output of the standalone FOP core (js/cost_basis_fop_core.js, P3) for one ledger. Every figure is a Metric: a number, or null with the reason it is unavailable; an unknown is never 0. Current positions list only non-zero contracts; realized results of closed months stay in realizedByContract. The examples are the plan §9.6 three-roll case at a D mark of 71.8, and the same ledger with D unquoted. P3 must reproduce these numbers from the events; P1 only fixes the shape. The other two examples fix only how an unknown is carried: a baseline option whose opening premium is unknown (plan §9.2), and an as-of instant inside a composite delivery's time range (plan §8.1), where even the quantity of the two delivery contracts is a Count with a reason. P3 names the final reason codes.

valid.name: plan §9.6 after three rolls, D at 71.8
plan §9.6 with D unquoted: dependent totals are null with a reason
shape: a baseline option with unknown premium keeps its quantity and value
shape: an as-of instant inside a delivery range leaves both legs unknown

invalid.name: a metric is a value or a reason, not both
an unknown is never silently empty
an unknown premium is a reason, never an empty figure
a closed position is not listed with zero contracts
a quantity is a Count, not a bare number
an as-of view names its instant
